meta.title: Counter offer during evaluation time on one of the two lines; the vendor accepts
gaps: An existing RFQ in evaluation with two lines where Vendor A quoted 100 and 50; the prepared state provides one line and does not expose evaluation-time state.
Counter only line 1 while leaving a second line untouched, and verifying that the untouched line retains its original quote.
Verifying two-line Master QCS totals across both the countered and untouched lines.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: An existing RFQ in evaluation with two lines where Vendor A quoted 100 and 50; the prepared state provides one line and does not expose evaluation-time state.; Counter only line 1 while leaving a second line untouched, and verifying that the untouched line retains its original quote.; Verifying two-line Master QCS totals across both the countered and untouched lines.

steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ Responses screen containing the vendor's own bid.
Send a counter offer changing the supported bid line to 90.
Verify that the vendor's bid is marked as having a counter offer.
Act in the vendor portal and accept the pending counter offer.
Verify on the buyer side that the counter offer was accepted.
Open the buyer's Master QCS comparison after acceptance.
Verify that the accepted counter price is the current vendor rate.
Verify that Master QCS calculates the line amount and total from the current accepted price.
